posts.author: ReadListenThink
posts.text: I reckon we will hear deferred shipment as an excuse. It would be great if someone can bring up in the concall, the issues around management execution capabilities, possibility of increasing management capacity or doing management change etc. They should evaluate their growth against other CDMO businesses which were almost comparable sizes few years ago and have grown to become 1 lakh crore businesses and do some self reflection. They should really consider selling it to PE/VC funds and they can easily run and grow this much better.

posts.author: Aarti
posts.text: Q1 result is bad..as expected. I have mentioned multiple times that this company is structurally faulty. European operations were good - even that has turned loss making ! India operations has been making losses for years - very low utilisation. The negatives of this company are endless.. It will never revive until it is sold and another management takes over !!
